# Requirements Critique

Use this skill to challenge a requirement document before freeze.

## Procedure

1. Read the requirement document and identify all requirement IDs.
2. Check each requirement for clarity, testability, dependency, priority, and ownership.
3. Look for missing user states, error states, permissions, data lifecycle rules, operational needs, analytics, security, privacy, compliance, rollout, and support paths.
4. Identify contradictions and scope drift.
5. Rate findings as `Critical`, `High`, `Medium`, or `Low`.
6. Convert unresolved issues into open questions.
7. Give a freeze readiness verdict.

Use the review template: [review report template](./templates/review-report.md).
